Pt: PARKINSON, Harold J.   MRN: MW-00482915   DOB: 02/11/1933   Acct: 7730142268

Attending: Lucinda Okafor-Reyes, MD   Fellow: Tomasz Wiśniewski, MD   Resident: Priya Raghunathan, MD (PGY-2)

INTERVAL EVENTS
93 y/o man with advanced Parkinson's disease (Hoehn and Yahr stage 4), oropharyngeal dysphagia and prior aspiration events, transferred from Larkspur Gardens Assisted Living (Huber Heights) with aspiration pneumonia, sepsis with septic shock and hypoxemic respiratory failure. Overnight Mr. Parkinson had one desaturation to 84% with thick secretions, resolved with suctioning and FiO2 0.50 for 1 h. Norepinephrine weaned 0.12 -> 0.04 mcg/kg/min. Afebrile x 36 h. Daughter Deborah "Debbie" Kowalczyk (HCPOA, cell 937-555-0182) visited last evening and was updated by Dr. Raghunathan.

VITALS / I&O
Tmax 37.8 C | HR 88 NSR | BP 108/62 (MAP 77) on norepi 0.04 | RR 18 (set) | SpO2 95%
In 2.1 L / out 1.4 L, net +0.7 L; LOS +5.2 L. UOP 0.6 mL/kg/h.

BY SYSTEMS
Neuro: fentanyl 25 mcg/h; propofol off since 0400. RASS -1, CAM-ICU negative. Follows simple commands, moves all 4 extremities; bilateral rigidity with cogwheeling c/w Parkinson disease. Continue carbidopa-levodopa 25/100 two tabs q4h while awake via OGT. Do NOT hold doses (risk of parkinsonism-hyperpyrexia syndrome).
Resp: ETT 7.5, 23 cm at lip, intubated 10/10. VC 450/5, FiO2 0.40, RR 18. ABG 7.38/41/92, P/F 230, Pplat 22. Failed SBT yesterday (RSBI 118). Plan PS 10/5 trial after noon, reassess for extubation 10/15 with RT (J.B.). CXR: improving RLL consolidation.
CV: Septic shock, improving. Goal MAP > 65, wean norepi off today. Lactate 1.4 (4.6 on admit). TTE 10/10: EF 55%, no RWMA.
ID: Aspiration pneumonia; sputum cx mixed oropharyngeal flora, blood cx 10/9 NGTD x2. Pip-tazo narrowed to ampicillin-sulbactam 3 g q6h on 10/13, day 6 of 7.
Renal/FEN: AKI resolving, Cr 1.6 -> 1.1. K 3.8, Mg 1.9 (repleted).
GI/Nutrition: Osmolite 1.5 at goal 50 mL/h via OGT. SLP to re-evaluate after extubation; remains very high aspiration risk.
Heme: Hgb 9.1, Plt 164. DVT ppx heparin 5,000 units SC q8h.
Endo: SSI, BG 120-170.
Skin: stage 2 sacral pressure injury, WOC RN following.
Lines/tubes: R IJ triple-lumen CVC (10/9, day 6), L radial arterial line, OGT, Foley (remove once off pressors).

SOCIAL
Widowed, retired tool-and-die machinist (Miami Valley Tool & Die). Has lived at the ALF since 2021.

ASSESSMENT / PLAN
93-year-old man with Parkinson's disease, septic shock from aspiration pneumonia and hypoxemic respiratory failure, improving. Wean norepi, PS trial today, continue ampicillin-sulbactam. Code status: FULL CODE, confirmed with HCPOA at family meeting 10/12; revisit if he fails extubation. PCP Dr. Glen Underwood (Kettering Family Practice, fax 937-555-0119) notified.

Critical care time: 45 minutes, excluding procedures.
